entries.name: Annie
entries.summary: Annie has been underperforming a bit for a while now for the average player, so we're looking to give a little more fire-power and also help support her burning Tibbers build.

lines.after: 1275 - 4000 (Scaling with Champion Level) (+50% AP) (+150% Bonus HP)

entries.name: Azir
entries.summary: Hello again, bird gang. We've been keeping an eye on Azir's performance as he shifts from PTA to Lethal Tempo usage. His buffs from 26.21 landed a little lower than expected, so we're giving him a little more love. Note that the attack range increase does not impact his attack range with soldiers—only when he's stuck with his own basic attacks!

entries.name: Bard
entries.summary: Bard has been in a pretty weak state after pro focused nerfs earlier this year, and has stopped building AP entirely. So, we're giving him a little boost to his Q base damage and ratio.

entries.name: Ezreal
entries.summary: Ezreal has been underperforming at most ranks this entire year, despite still being very meta in pro play. Now that we are in the post pro play season, we're giving him a few buffs to help him succeed more in your games at home.

entries.name: Galio
entries.summary: Galio's been a bit weak lately, and we want to take the time to buff him, especially to help out his weaker AP bruiser-y builds rather than only helping his current heavy AP one.

lines.text: Shield Amount (Also affects R): 7.5 / 9 / 10.5 / 12 / 13.5% of his Max HP ⇒ 8 / 11 / 14 / 17 / 20% of his Max HP

entries.name: Gnar
entries.summary: Like Ezreal, Gnar may be a top pick for pros, but he hasn't been performing as well in the rest of skill brackets, so we're giving his throwing arm a buff to give him a helping hand. / Boulder Toss

entries.name: K'Sante
entries.summary: K'Sante is another staple in pro play at Worlds, but he isn't nearly as performant for everyone else, especially in late game where he falls off a cliff unlike most tanks.

lines.text: All Out Charge Time Damage Increase: 10 / 27.5 / 45 / 62.5 / 80% damage ⇒ 10 / 26.25 / 42.5 / 58.75 / 75% damage
lines.attr: All Out Charge Time Damage Increase

entries.name: LeBlanc
entries.summary: LeBlanc's damage is sitting a little too high, especially on her very dependable Q, so we're tamping down her scaling ratio to make her less oppressive, especially when snowballing.

lines.text: Ability Power Ratio (Both Initial and Mark): 40% AP ⇒ 35% AP
lines.attr: Ability Power Ratio (Both Initial and Mark)

entries.name: Master Yi
entries.summary: We've been keeping an eye on Master Yi for a few patches as the buffs, his Q Cooldown Refund, QoL adjustments, and jungle meta changes have settled. We think he's still a bit strong, and are tapping him down in a way that should mostly impact his crit build which has become his dominant play style, rather than his on-hit.

lines.text: Maximum Single Target Damage: 35 / 70 / 105 / 140 / 175 (+122.5% AD) ⇒ 35 / 70 / 105 / 140 / 175 (+105% AD). Reminder that this can also Critically Strike for bonus damage.
lines.after: 35 / 70 / 105 / 140 / 175 (+105% AD). Reminder that this can also Critically Strike for bonus damage.

entries.name: Mel
entries.summary: Mel's rework has landed directionally as we hoped as a moderate buff without affecting her ban rate. She's still a bit weaker than a standard champion and could use a little more firepower, so we're giving a little more strength to her Q and W.

entries.name: Syndra
entries.summary: Syndra's stun feels a bit too available, so we're making it both more costly and higher cooldown early. These changes are also designed to make sure we're not pushing her into further reliance on high haste builds, and curb the ability to avoid mana investment.

entries.name: Vel'Koz
entries.summary: We made a small error in Vel'Koz's math. He is very displeased with us. This won't have any realistic impact on his power level.

entries.name: Vi
entries.summary: Now that the pro season is over, we want to give Vi a little more strength to boost her numbers in the rest of the ladder.

entries.name: Voltaic Cyclosword
entries.summary: Voltaic has been a bit too dominant as both an all-in and a poke lethality item. All-inning power is of higher importance to assassin functionality than the raw poke it's providing, so we're tuning down its trigger damage.

lines.text: Bonus Damage: [9% || 7%] target's current hp ⇒ [8% || 6%] target's current hp

mayhem.title: ARAM: Mayhem
mayhem.intro: We're back with more content and balance changes for ARAM Mayhem! Four new Headliners are hitting the stage, bringing new ways to play. Whether you're looking for a second chance at life with Arcade, protecting your team with La Ilusion, getting rich with Debonair, or finding the perfect Augment with Maestro, we're excited for you to enjoy the show. We've also been keeping an eye on how the new set is playing out and listening to your feedback. Turrets have been falling a little too quickly, barely slowing down enemies and buying little-to-no time for their teams. We're experimenting with turret playing and increasing their defenses so games don't end in a blink. Tanks have had a particularly tough time keeping up with the chaos, so we're introducing four new tank-focused Augments to help our beefier champions stay in the fight. We're also making another round of champion balance adjustments to give some struggling picks a helping hand while bringing down a few overperformers. Finally, we're dialing back Bouncing Bees and Boom and the Bass, which have been putting out a little more damage than we'd like. As always, thank you for playing and keep the feedback coming!

entries.name: Fortified
entries.summary: Gain 20 Armor, then increase your bonus Armor by 25%.

entries.name: Mystic Guard
entries.summary: Gain 20 Magic Resist, then increase your bonus Magic Resist by 25%.

entries.name: Slime Time
entries.summary: Every few seconds, Autocast a burst of slime from your body, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. If you hit a champion, secrete a blob that heals you when walked over.

entries.name: Steadfaster presence
entries.summary: Gain bonus Armor, Magic Resist, and Tenacity. This bonus increases when you're below 40% maximum Health.

entries.name: Arcade
entries.summary: Collect Tokens by getting Takedowns. Cash in 4 Tokens to revive while dead.

entries.name: Debonair
entries.summary: Augments grant additional gold.

entries.name: La Ilusion
entries.summary: Allies drop a candle on death. Pick it up to shield yourself and nearby allies.

entries.name: Maestro
entries.summary: Allows you to choose from 4 Augments.

lines.text: Prismatic Anvil: Capped at 1 per team per game

entries.name: Turret Plating
entries.summary: Turrets in Mayhem now have 120 Armor and 120 Magic Resistance, and no longer have their resists lowered as the game goes on. Outer and inhibitor Mayhem turrets now have Turret Plating. Plating separates the health bar into thirds, with destroyed plates giving 100g split among the team nearby. On plate destruction, the tower gets a Bulwark buff that grants 60-80 resists per nearby champion.

entries.name: Aurelion Sol
entries.summary: The majority of Aurelion Sol players have made it pretty clear that they would much rather rank up his Singularity (E) second over his Astral Flight (W) even though it’s a much weaker second max. We agree that his (E) is a very cool signature spell, so we’re giving him a buff there to help make doing the intuitive fun thing the right thing.

entries.name: Corki
entries.summary: We were cautious about Corki’s power level going into Worlds, but now (like Azir and Orianna), he has some more space to be better for everyone. Big One Damage: 180 / 340 / 500 (+170% bonus AD) ⇒ 200 / 380 / 560 (+180% bonus AD)

entries.name: Kayle
entries.summary: We've seen Kayle's relevance decrease steadily from earlier this year as the game’s moved past the top lane shake up from role quests. We’re giving her a small bump to help out her early laning since we believe that top lane could use some more scaling options.

entries.name: Locke
entries.summary: While Locke's performance in general is within reason, he's proven to be a much deeper champion than we initially expected and players who have reached that level of Locke play have shown him to still be clearly too strong, especially early game. Maximum Stack Damage: 75.6 / 109.2 / 142.8 / 176.4 / 210 ⇒ 63 / 92.4 / 121.8 / 151.2 / 180.6

entries.name: Maokai
entries.summary: Maokai has remained a very still tree this year, and has been almost entirely stuck in support. We’re buffing him in a way that helps out his top and jungle more.

entries.name: Mel
entries.summary: This patch, Mel is getting a midscope adjustment. You can read more about it here. For the spark notes version, she is having some power moved from early game to scaling, her W is being reworked into an Area-of-Effect missile destruction that retaliates rather than reflects effects, and her Q and R are getting adjustments to lower their cooldowns later on in the game so she can stack her passive to ever higher amounts.

entries.name: Naafiri
entries.summary: After a series of nerfs earlier this year, Naafiri has largely fallen out of mid lane entirely and has been pretty mediocre in the jungle. We’re giving her a buff that should primarily help out her mid, bringing her role power closer to parity.

parts.title: W - The Call of the Pack

entries.name: Rumble
entries.summary: Similar to Corki, Rumble was tuned for pro play. This change should help out the average rumble a bit more than pros when they catch back up to the patch cycle. Maximum Damage Ability Power Ratio: 175% AP ⇒ 200% AP

entries.name: Shen
entries.summary: Along with Maokai, Shen jungle has been pushed too far out of the meta. We were watching to see if some of the previous patches’ changes to help jungle tanks would bring him back up, but now we’re confident we can just buff him .

entries.name: Smolder
entries.summary: Our buffs a few patches ago landed a bit softer than we expected, but he’s ended up with a good balance between his Crit and Caster builds, so we’re giving him a more generic buff this time. We also expect the Doran’s Bow nerf in this patch to help him out a bit.

entries.name: Thresh
entries.summary: Despite our prior nerf, Thresh has remained at the very top of the support pecking order for top tier players, so it’s time for another.

entries.name: Viktor
entries.summary: Last patch's nerf to Viktor hit him harder than we expected - but we are happy about the impact it had on his early game bullying, so we are buffing him back in scaling.

entries.name: Yasuo
entries.summary: We were on the fence last patch with whether Yasuo would also need a nerf like Yone, but he's also continued growing in winrate as players migrate to crit builds and banrate reflecting that so he's getting the same treatment.

entries.name: Zaahen
entries.summary: Zaahen is living up to his scaling fantasies, but hasn’t had enough to do in lane. This should make his early scrapping and skirmishing much more satisfying.

entries.name: Doran's Bow
entries.summary: We’re nerfing Doran's Bow by a minor amount, as it’s settled into a spot that is slightly but clearly too strong, resulting in marksmen that we expect to be leaning towards Doran's Blade instead being almost purely Doran's Bow users.

entries.name: Overlord's Bloodmail
entries.summary: Overlord's should be one of the premier juggernaut capstone items, but outside of Sett hasn't been able to carry enough power to justify greeding for. We are adjusting Overlords in a way that should be a net buff for most other users while hopefully not ballooning its power level too far on Sett, who benefits the most from the Retribution passive because of synergy with his Haymaker (W). Retribution: +0 - 12% total AD, based on % Missing Health ⇒ +0 - 10% total AD, based on % Missing Health

mayhem.title: ARAM: Mayhem
mayhem.intro: Hello Superstars! This patch, we’re lowering the power of some new augments on the scene, buffing some survivability augments, and fixing a bunch of bugs. We’ve been monitoring the explosiveness of combat in the new update and want to alleviate some of the more frustrating situations. Fighters have become exceptionally good at closing out games and poke dominates early in the most recent update while tanks have been struggling. We’re aiming to bring down the power of some of the augments that have been making tanks feel so fragile like Take ‘Em Down Down Down and Weapon of Destiny. We’re also bringing up the power of survivability augments like Soul Eater and Stay Resolute. We're looking at overall burst and game pacing right now to make sure things don’t feel too snowbally. The stage crews have also finished setting up on Butcher’s Bridge and Koeshin’s Crossing so both of those maps will be back in the rotation with Headliner performances. With Worlds in full swing, the last page of the Journey to Stardom is now accessible. Complete all the missions and make your way to the Worlds stage to earn all the rewards! Two new augments are also joining the fray including one based on a classic World’s Anthem that’ll definitely make your enemies remember you. As always, thank you for playing and for all your feedback!

entries.name: Azir
entries.summary: We've kept the Emperor of the Sands’ mana pool pretty dry to make sure he needs to use soldier attacks properly for lane control early instead of just spamming [Q] Conquering Sands, but this is overly restrictive now that there are strong rank up incentives on his [W] Arise! We’re buffing his Mana Growth so he can more freely use his abilities to contest lane.

entries.name: Caitlyn
entries.summary: Caitlyn’s been at a very high pick and ban rate for most players for months now despite adjustments to other marksmen and the bot meta, so it's time to nerf her. We have felt that her late-game scaling has been too strong for a while now, so we’re moving some of her power from her eyepopping full build headshots into her early game Q damage to rebalance her power curve.

lines.text: Damage: 60 - 100% AD (+1% AD per 1% per Crit Chance) (+1% AD per 1% Bonus Crit Damage) ⇒ 60 - 80% AD (+0.8% AD per 1% per Crit Chance) (+0.8% AD per 1% Bonus Crit Damage)

lines.after: 60 - 80% AD (+0.8% AD per 1% per Crit Chance) (+0.8% AD per 1% Bonus Crit Damage)

entries.name: Darius
entries.summary: Darius has moved a bit too far away from being a persistently durable damage threat that needs to be kited to more of a one shot combo playstyle. Since he has some room for power, we’re giving him a slight boost so he can swing that axe more often in sustained fights.

entries.name: Jinx
entries.summary: Like her best friend Caitlyn, Jinx has been similarly dominant in the meta, even with the Hurricane nerf last patch. We’re slowing her roll to make it a tad harder to get her snowballing.

entries.name: Lee Sin
entries.summary: Lee Sin has continued to be extremely popular since his adjustments to how his [W] Safeguard cooldown works with allies. While we like the extra flexibility that has given him, it's a bit too much power, so we’re nerfing the cooldown a bit along with a minor bug fix to how his E reveal works against invisible enemies and another small nerf to his [R] Dragon's Rage damage.

lines.text: Bugfix: No longer reveals invisible enemies if they stealth after being hit by Tempest.
Collision Damage: 175 / 400 / 625 (+200% bonus AD) (+12 / 15 / 18% Kicked Champion's Health) ⇒ 150 / 350 / 550 (+200% bonus AD) (+12 / 15 / 18% Kicked Champion's Health)

entries.name: Locke
entries.summary: Locke’s been out for long enough now that we have a better picture of where he’s overly excelling and where he’s falling a bit short. Some of those areas are his extremely generous mana tuning and ability to shrug off harass, and we’re also refining his power curve by improving his scaling damage slightly, because he falls off a bit too fast if he’s not able to close out games early.

entries.name: Miss Fortune
entries.summary: Miss Fortune has been in a relatively decent place throughout the year, but with the Hubris nerf this patch, we’re looking to compensate with a couple buffs to her damage output.

lines.text: Critical Strike Damage: 130% (+0.3% per 1% Bonus Crit Damage) ⇒ 145% (+0.45% per 1% Bonus Crit Damage)

entries.name: Nidalee
entries.summary: Our favorite huntress has been sitting at an extremely high winrate in high skill brackets, toeing the line into overpowered territory for some time now, even if she's not currently meta. Now that we’re bringing down the power of some other powerful meta junglers like Lee Sin, we’re giving Nidalee a minor nerf to prevent her from getting out of paw.

entries.name: Nunu & Willump
entries.summary: The boy and his yeti lost some power when we nerfed Hextech Rocketbelt earlier this year so that ranged mages weren't just buying it for a dash to safety, so we’re restoring some of that damage elsewhere.

entries.name: Orianna
entries.summary: We’re tapping up Orianna’s scalings to help her chunk a bit harder with her bread-and-butter combo in the late game without giving too much additional power to her laning phase.

entries.name: Qiyana
entries.summary: Damage on Qiyana's Q turned out to be a lot more impactful than we anticipated, so we’re partially reverting the buff we gave her back in 26.17.

parts.title: Q - Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal

entries.name: Rammus
entries.summary: While Nidalee's winrate has been borderline overpowered in the high skill levels, Rammus has been rolling over pretty much everyone else, so he’s getting a light nerf too, ok?

lines.text: Bonus Magic Resistance: 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 (+30 - 60% Magic Resistance) ⇒ 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 (+30 - 50% Magic Resistance)

entries.name: Ryze
entries.summary: After the significantly early game nerfs to Ryze in 26.19, he hasn't been rewarded enough for succeeding when he does scale, so we’re buffing that.

lines.text: Flux Bonus Damage: 15% / 40% / 65% / 90% increased damage ⇒ 10% / 40% / 70% / 100% increased damage

entries.name: Sion
entries.summary: Our favorite unstoppable juggernaut is looking rather stoppable in recent patches. We’re giving him some buffs to his baseline durability and rewarding him when he succeeds at using his ult to GET IN THERE rather than run away.

lines.text: Damage Increase over the First 3s of Channeling: +0 - 166.67% Base Damage, 0 - 100% Ratio Damage ⇒ +0 - 200%
lines.attr: Damage Increase over the First 3s of Channeling

lines.text: Bugfix: Tooltip now displays the correct minimum and maximum bonus AD ratios (40-120%). It displayed an incorrect Bonus AD Scaling (60%-120%). It was never actually changed in patch 25.16 beyond the tooltip.

entries.name: Taliyah
entries.summary: Taliyah is one of a handful of mage junglers, and we think she can be better supported for meta diversity. We’re buffing her [E] Unraveled Earth damage to make it more satisfying to land her CC combo.

lines.text: Monster Damage: Deals 225% damage to monsters.

entries.name: Taric
entries.summary: We're smoothing out some of the rough edges in Taric’s kit to allow him to shine a bit more. Way back in the day, Taric’s W was adjusted to combat the popular Master Yi + Taric funnel strats. A consequence of this was that his spells would fizzle if they were cast at the same time that his bound ally became untargetable. We believe this harsh restriction to how his abilities function is no longer necessary given the existence of Role Quests, so we're partially reverting this change so that spells now work on untargetable allies, though we are still keeping an existing exemption on [E] Dazzle for champions that disappear on screen because the gameplay is too unclear (sorry, Master Yi).

lines.text: Cast Behavior: Q casts when allies are untargetable will now successfully fire.
Cast Behavior: E casts when allies are untargetable will now successfully fire.
Tooltip: Updated to include “Dazzle will not cast from Vanished allies”.
Cast Behavior: R casts when allies are untargetable will now successfully fire.

entries.name: Tristana
entries.summary: Tristana’s early laning has devolved a bit into "Level 1 press [Q] and just auto attack to take complete control of the lane", which is a pretty low gameplay and off flavor way for her to succeed. We’re hitting her early [Q] attack speed so she’ll have to work a bit harder before jumping on her foes.

entries.name: Twisted Fate
entries.summary: Alongside the Taric QoL changes, we’re giving Twisted Fate’s R the same treatment so he can reveal champs even if they’re untargetable at the time of activation.

entries.name: Varus
entries.summary: In this set of changes, we’re mainly looking to snipe top lane Varus, where he tends to max W, unlike the more common Q max in bot. This won't bring his [Q] Piercing Arrow back up to prior Lethality Varus levels of power, but we believe it will help a lot with our ability to tune him for bot lane. As a maxed ability, it also offers more gameplay to Varus and his opponents to interact with than some more passive damage on W.

entries.name: Vel'Koz
entries.summary: Vel’Koz has been a fairly quiet pick this year, having little presence or meta impact in mid and support. We’re looking to give him a little bit of help by rewarding him for landing his combos.

entries.name: Viktor
entries.summary: It’s time for the Glorious…Devolution. It seems Viktor has evolved past the point of exploitable weaknesses, so we’re opening that up a bit by making him slightly more vulnerable in early game skirmishes and across the board.

entries.name: Wukong
entries.summary: Like Lee and Qiyana, Wukong has been a meta staple whirlwind of a force in the jungle for a while now. We’re looking to tap down his strength in the jungle while compensating for lane Wukong.

entries.name: Xin Zhao
entries.summary: Following Sundered Sky's nerfs, we feel like Xin Zhao has room for buffs to both his AD Bruiser and AS focused builds, so we’re helping out his scalings.

entries.name: Yone
entries.summary: The last changes to Yone successfully got him to start considering crit in his first item purchases, but also put him at a somewhat unsustainable power level. We are giving him a moderate nerf to bring him down a bit.

entries.name: Zyra
entries.summary: Like Vel'koz, Zyra has had relatively little impact in the meta as tanks and enchanter supports have reigned supreme. We’re giving Zyra a greener thumb this patch to help her combat the forces trampling over her plants.

entries.name: Bastion Breaker
entries.summary: Bastion Breaker was buffed into being a bit of a generic stat stick in order to give it a proper swing in the meta. Now, we’re nerfing that generic power with a QoL improvement to keep it a satisfying item in its niche.

entries.name: Dawncore
entries.summary: Dawncore is the enchanter capstone that isn’t, and currently only Soraka picks it up. Even when other supports get to full build, they often prefer other purchases. We’re buffing its AP value to make it less purely bound to Healing and Shielding.

lines.attr: Ability Power per 100% Base Mana Regeneration

entries.name: Gluttonous Greaves
entries.summary: The greaves are overperforming for marksmen, even when getting very few stacks, so we’re hitting it with a nerf to its cost to delay early acquisitions from getting too much value.

entries.name: Hubris
entries.summary: While Hubris has been a bit weak for melee champions, it’s clearly been overperforming for ranged users. We’re delineating between the two now to encourage melees and disincentivize ranged users from building it.

lines.text: Base Bonus Attack Damage: 12 ⇒ 15 Melee / 10 Ranged
Bonus Attack Damage per Stack: 3 ⇒ 3 Melee / 2 Ranged

mayhem.title: ARAM: Mayhem
mayhem.intro: Welcome to the latest ARAM Mayhem release - “Journey to Stardom”. The stars have certainly come out to play as each game of Mayhem will now feature a Headliner performance that applies a unique twist to the rules of each game. Each iconic band will be playing their music while you battle, so make sure you enable your sound and turn up the volume! STAGE CREW ANNOUNCEMENT: It’s taking a little longer to set up the concert stages on Butcher’s Bridge and Koeshin’s Crossing, so expect those maps to be unavailable in Mayhem queues for this patch but return next patch. Along with our Headliners, we have a TON of new augments for you to enjoy. With this release we’ll also be removing some augments and wishing them a fond farewell. But who knows? Maybe they’ll be back some day for an encore. We also have a brand new progression experience where you’ll be completing missions from members K/DA, Pentakill, and other bands. Completing these missions unlocks awesome rewards like Augments, emotes, orange essence, and more! Playing games and completing missions will move you up Superstar Ranks that unlock new bands and new missions. Go from a Newbie to a Superstar performing on the Worlds stage! Silver Blue Barrier

lines.text: K/DA: Collect 4 K/DA Cards to earn an extra Augment!
HEARTSTEEL: Augments can come with unique modifiers making them extra strong.
True Damage: Takedowns and destroying towers can drop Anvils for your team.
Pentakill: Increase the power of one of your abilities at the start of the game and at level 18.
Disco: Dance under the disco ball to earn Gold for everyone.
Cafe Cuties: Health relics are especially powerful.
Bees: Collect the honey pots and avoid the bees that fly across the map.
Command Line: Reroll one of your augments to be a higher tier in every selection.
Gain a Shield whenever you cast an Ability based on the mana cost.
Using a specific ability grants you stacking Attack Speed.
Enemy Champion takedowns create Fruit that can be picked up by you and your allies for healing.
All Bonus Health from your items is converted to Lethality.
Your Attacks deal extra damage if fired from max range.
Gain Ability Power based on your Bonus Health.
Gain Armor, Magic Resistance, and Attack Speed for every enemy Champion around you.
All mana from your items is converted to Ability Power.

entries.name: Ultimate Recursion
entries.summary: Gold Arcane Axiom

lines.text: Takedowns refund a portion of your Ultimate Cooldown.
Using an Ability causes your next Attack to deal additional damage based on your Armor.
Your abilities occasionally fling an exploding beehive at your enemies that deals damage, slows, and applies On-Hit effects.
Gain a Summoner Spell that allows you to charge up a horn blast to knock back and damage your enemies.
One of your Abilities marks enemy champions; consuming the mark deals extra damage and reduces the cooldown of your Ability.
Damaging enemy champions with two separate abilities in quick succession grants permanent Mana and deals additional damage.
Healing and Shielding allies summons butterflies. Once you have enough butterflies, they’ll fly at enemies you damage, dealing additional damage.
Gain a Summoner Spell that allows you to jump on a destructive rocket and drive it into your enemies.
Gain Attack Damage, Ability Power, and Attack Speed but decrease your own Move Speed. Every Takedown increases this effect and dying decreases the effect.
Your Ultimate Ability can now critically strike.
One of your abilities will launch you backwards when you fire it.
Falling to low Health pushes back enemies and heals allies.
Every 10 seconds, your next Attack deals additional damage and heals you.
Gain Attack Damage, Ability Power, and Lifesteal based on how low your Health is.
Damage an enemy champion five times with Attacks and Abilities to gain a burst of healing and extra damage.
After casting an Ability, your next attack deals bonus damage and grants you a burst of Move Speed.
All Attack Damage from your items is converted to Attack Speed.
When Stormsurge applies Squall, it now detonates in an area, dealing additional damage and marking enemies with a secondary Squall.

entries.name: Weapon Of Destiny
entries.summary: Prismatic Big Shot

lines.text: The first Legendary Item you buy gets stronger stats with every takedown.
A large percent of your Attack Speed is converted to Critical Strike Damage.

After using an ability, your next Attack bounces to nearby enemies, prioritizing enemy champions. Complete the quest by bouncing your Attacks to enemy champions to gain additional bounces and Attack Damage.
One of your Abilities that heals or shields also heals or shields nearby allies.
Using your Ultimate Ability grants you increased Health and creates a zone around you that slows Enemy Champions. Takedowns increase the amount of Bonus Health you get and the size of the slow zone.
Attacking an enemy champion three times deals a burst of damage and grants you a burst of Attack Speed.
Gain a Summoner Spell that lets you “Dance with Death”, granting you immortality for 5 seconds, but if you don’t get a takedown during that time, you’ll get dragged to the underworld.

entries.name: Ambessa
entries.summary: Ambessa has been too reliable in her late game output for players with high mastery in all brackets, but especially pro-play.

entries.name: Ashe
entries.summary: Ashe is one of the premier marksmen in pro play at the moment, and we're seeing her output too much raw damage given her position as the highest utility marksman in the game.

entries.name: Cassiopeia
entries.summary: Our changes two patches ago to Cassiopeia have been pretty good directionally, with most players being proportionally less impacted from those adjustments than pros. We're taking another swing at her early resources because of how dominant she still is in early laning, making her work a little harder to create an advantage.

entries.name: Diana
entries.summary: While Diana's assassin build shines, her bruiser builds tend to be lagging a good bit behind. We want to inject a bit more power into that playstyle.

entries.name: Kennen
entries.summary: Stacking the odds a bit more in his favor with his signature spell (in Riftbound) and offsetting Rocketbelt changes that he'll be a bit less excited about.

entries.name: Kindred
entries.summary: Kindred is currently a bit weak, so we're giving them buffs in areas that won't make them much more overwhelming in early invades. Optimistically, they'd also make a pretty unique addition to the meta.

entries.name: K'Sante
entries.summary: Warding off this warden from being as reliable as a blind pick in coordinated play - hurting early mana and consistent W damage reduction, which should be skewed for elite audiences.

entries.name: Lillia
entries.summary: Last patch we looked to inject a bit more power into the deer, but didn't quite see the movement we were looking for. We believe there is a bit more room for her to really prance around various levels of play so we are following up with another buff that'll really help her shine.

entries.name: Lucian
entries.summary: Last patch's adjustment to help normalize mid and bot performance ended up landing as a nerf for bot lane, so we're following up with a buff to make up for the lost power.

entries.name: Mordekaiser
entries.summary: Windows between Mordekaiser's ultimates make it hard to keep up with the pace of much of his opposition. His bread and butter (Q) can also feel less impactful as the pace of the game increases, so we think it can do more damage later on.

entries.name: Neeko
entries.summary: Rocketbelt's adjustment this patch will probably land as a small nerf for Neeko, so we're giving her some minor compensation

entries.name: Smolder
entries.summary: Smolder has lost quite a bit of power over the last few patches, with the Cleaver ranged nerf and bot lane meta changes disfavoring him significantly. We're further encouraging crit builds to bring his bruiser and full crit builds closer in power.

lines.text: Super Scorcher Bonus Magic Damage: 25 - 55% (+0-9% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance ⇒ 25 - 60% (+0-10.5% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance
lines.before: 25 - 55% (+0-9% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance
lines.after: 25 - 60% (+0-10.5% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance

lines.attr: Flap Flap Flap Bonus Magic Damage
lines.before: 8 - 12.8% (+0-1.44% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance
lines.after: 8 - 14% (+0-1.8% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance

entries.name: Swain
entries.summary: We're giving Swain mid a moderate buff this patch while also making an adjustment that should help normalize his mid and bot lane performance.

entries.name: Tahm Kench
entries.summary: As one of the tank supports with the lowest health regen, and many health scaling values on his abilities, Tahm Kench lost out on the recent adjustments to the support item. We're giving him compensation for that.

entries.name: Vayne
entries.summary: Vayne has settled into a fairly weak spot, and while we still aren't totally happy with her top vs bot skew, we're getting closer. We're adjusting her base stats to help in bot where she needs to weather harass, and reverting a mana cost to her Q that simply felt way too bad.

entries.name: Yunara
entries.summary: Yunara is the leading candidate for "handshake hyperscaler do nothing" and we want to avoid that becoming the dominant meta, especially heading into worlds.

lines.text: Slow Stacking: Stacks with other slows ⇒ No longer stacks with other slows
lines.after: No longer stacks with other slows

entries.name: Experimental Hexplate
entries.summary: We've been fairly unhappy with how this item has played out for ranged users, especially as a first rush in top lane where it makes them too resilient to burst and too lethal during all ins.

lines.text: Ranged Mod: 70% of Value (35% Attack Speed, 14% Move Speed) ⇒ 50% of Value (25% Attack Speed, 10% Move Speed)
lines.before: 70% of Value (35% Attack Speed, 14% Move Speed)
lines.after: 50% of Value (25% Attack Speed, 10% Move Speed)

entries.name: Hextech Rocketbelt
entries.summary: Rocketbelt continues to be used a bit too much as an escape compared to a risky engage tool, so we are pulling back on its generic value in favor of emphasizing aggressive action with it, especially for AP Bruisers who rely on it for all ins.

entries.name: Runaan's Hurricane
entries.summary: This item was slightly overbuffed, so pulling back on that a bit. Our recent systemic buff-bar clarity work moved a lot of numbers from buffs onto items. These numbers began terrorizing your scoreboards (thanks, Death's Dance). The scoreboard should show strategically relevant information, not noisy in-the-moment combat state, and we're hiding most item numbers on the scoreboard to reflect this principle. Strategically relevant item numbers, like Tear of the Goddess items and Mejai's Soulstealer, remain on the scoreboard icons. The following items' icon counters are now hidden on the scoreboard:

mayhem.title: ARAM: Mayhem
mayhem.intro: Hello Mayhemers! This patch, we're giving some champions and Augments that need a little love some extra attention. For champions, we're introducing champion-specific buffs that strengthen their core play patterns while also making them more accessible and satisfying to play in Mayhem. For Augments, we're continuing to focus on usability improvements. For example, Missile Split will now split when the missile reaches its end or is recast, rather than on the first target hit. We also lowered the cooldown on Triggered Inferno to show the real Samira fantasy. Let us know how these changes feel, and thank you for playing. See you on the Bridge!

lines.text: Meep Auto Damage per Chime Breakpoint: 6 per 3 chimes ⇒ 10 per 3 chimes
lines.attr: Meep Auto Damage per Chime Breakpoint

lines.text: W Shield Strength: 18% Bonus Health ⇒ 20% Bonus Health
W Passive Stacks: 0.4 per minion kill ⇒ 0.75 per minion kill
E Shield Strength: 13.5% bonus health ⇒ 15% bonus health
Passive Attack Speed: 40% bonus Attack Speed ⇒ 50% bonus Attack Speed

Fixed a bug where King Me transmute to Overloaded causes Overloaded to be non-functional.

Fixed a bug where a move command can change Echo Cast's Clone direction.
Fixed a bug where Lucian's (W) missile fails to split with Spell Split augment when casting (E) during the spell cast.

Fixed a bug where champions are unable to queue other spells when casting an Ability enhanced by the Spell Split Augment.
Fixed a bug where Prom Queen's cooldown icon disappears upon death.
Fixed a bug where Urgot (W) missile would destroy Rite of Ascension's Soul.
Fixed a bug where Minion Mancer's damage amplification did not work on Shaco (R) Explosion and Ivern R's knockup.
Fixed a bug where Ultra Hydra's quest and card icon did not match up.

entries.name: Aatrox
entries.summary: We think The Darkin Blade has lost a fair bit of power with Sundered Sky nerfs that were aimed more at opening up the jungle meta, so we are giving him a bump so he remains a world-ending threat.

lines.text: Health Heal Ratio: 1.1% per 100 bonus health ⇒ 1.3% per 100 bonus health

entries.name: Aphelios
entries.summary: Aphelios has been kiting the spotlight for a while now, even though he's a hypercarry in an enchanter meta that should favor him, so we're looking to give him a little boost to encourage him to get out of his comfort zone.

lines.text: Moonshot Damage: 70 - 160 (+42 - 60% bonus AD) (+100% AP) ⇒ 80 - 170 (+42 - 60% bonus AD) (+100% AP)
Slow: 30% for 2.5 seconds, decaying to 10% after 0.7 seconds ⇒ 30% for 2.5 seconds, decaying to 15% after 0.7 seconds
lines.before: 30% for 2.5 seconds, decaying to 10% after 0.7 seconds
lines.after: 30% for 2.5 seconds, decaying to 15% after 0.7 seconds

lines.before: 15% AD, decreasing by 1.5% AD to a minimum of 5% AD for the 8th+ chakram
lines.after: 16% AD, decreasing by 1.5% AD to a minimum of 5% AD for the 9th+ chakram

entries.name: Aurora
entries.summary: Despite not receiving any changes since last year, Aurora has fallen off as we've had to nerf Rocketbelt into a fairer state. We're giving our favorite Bryni a bit more power in her waveclear and outplay potential with her ultimate.

entries.name: Draven
entries.summary: Since all bot laners received significantly increased gold income thanks to role quests, Draven's potential to gain a gold advantage through his Adoration stacks has lost some of its impact. We're giving him a helping hand (axe?) by tapping up his early game damage.

entries.name: Elise
entries.summary: This year started strong for AP junglers that could use Dusk and Dawn, but others like Elise have been in a weak spot for a while, so we are helping out our friendly neighborhood spider with clear speed and damage.

entries.name: Fiora
entries.summary: Our Grand Duelist has room to shine a bit more when she succeeds after finding her opening, without giving her sharper 1v1 tools.

entries.name: Kha'Zix
entries.summary: Kha'Zix has been on the fringe of the meta now that the jungle is no longer dominated by Sundered Sky users. We are taking this opportunity to buff some of his weaker evolves to give him the flexibility to adapt and overcome.

entries.name: Lillia
entries.summary: Lillia is on the edge of being viable at higher levels of play and we believe her current pattern requires her to get in danger's way, so we're helping her durability. We also want to give Lillia opportunities to really be a playmaker so we're making the enemies she lullabies a little extra sleepy.

entries.name: Lucian
entries.summary: Years ago, we added the Vigilance Passive so Lucian bot players didn't feel like their champ was being nerfed because of mid laners, which ended up being super effective. We think now is a good opportunity to adjust the tuning of the passive and strike a balance between both roles.

entries.name: Master Yi
entries.summary: Somewhat overdue, but because Duskblade was removed a while ago, we're removing the Ability Haste penalty we had to apply to his Q CDR mechanic. This should have minimal impact on Summoner's Rift, but we see you Mayhem and Arena!

lines.text: Cooldown Refund on Hit: -1 second, scaling down with Ability Haste ⇒ 1 second
lines.before: -1 second, scaling down with Ability Haste

entries.name: Nasus
entries.summary: Nasus is difficult to keep down these days, and part of that is how quickly getting his early stacks leads to more reliable stacking. These higher highs will be compensated with some lower lows through some more vulnerability early on with lower damage and lifesteal lane sustain values off of that, and a bit longer before he really comes online.

entries.name: Nocturne
entries.summary: Nocturne has been a popular and powerful jungler in both pro and solo-queue for a while, so we're hitting the map presence and dueling power he benefits from through his ultimate.

entries.name: Poppy
entries.summary: Poppy's flex potential and jungle presence has been a bit problematic, suppressing many champions across the board as a strong counterpick. For this change, we're targeting her flexibility by reverting a previous buff to jungle clear.

entries.name: Rumble
entries.summary: At higher levels of play, we've seen Rumble continue to take over games, even after our changes earlier this year designed to hit his power in lane. Here, we're making some modifications to his passive that's much more elite-skewed, while giving Rumble in the Jungle some compensation.

entries.name: Ryze
entries.summary: Between strong itemization options and best-in-class skirmish and roam potential demonstrated by his most skilled players, it's high time we put some restraints on the archmage, while giving him some help with bad solo queue matchups.

lines.text: Flux Bonus Damage: 25 / 50 / 75 / 100% increased damage ⇒ 15 / 40 / 65 / 90% increased damage

entries.name: Vi
entries.summary: Vi has been a meta staple for the entire year, and now that Sundered Sky is in a better spot, we're going after her durability and early clear speed to make her a riskier pick who can still bring the pain if you are willing to build for it.

entries.name: Volibear
entries.summary: This year we've been carefully buffing up AD Volibear, but he remains on the weak side even with his very unique AP build. We're tuning him up to help him out across both the fringe AD build and his core AP build.

lines.text: Attack Speed per Stack: 5% (+3% per 100 AP) ⇒ 5% (+4% per 100 AP)
Lightning On-Hit Damage: 11 - 60 (Levels 1-18) (+45% AP) ⇒ 11 - 60 (Levels 1-18) (+45% AP) (+20% bonus AD)

rift.title: Items
rift.intro: We think melee supports have too much of their power in roaming and all-ins and are too weak in sustained laning. In response, we're shifting the flat health to health regen on World Atlas and Runic Compass, which will benefit them more due to their higher base health regen values.

rift.title: Systems
rift.intro: As the meta has continued to adjust to role quests, it's become clear that top lane is slightly weak, especially for split pushing. We're in turn buffing the cooldown of both the free role quest Teleport and upgraded Unleashed Teleport to promote those alternative strategies.

lines.text: Top Role Quest's Free Teleport Cooldown: 420 seconds ⇒ 390 seconds
lines.attr: Top Role Quest's Free Teleport Cooldown

lines.text: Top Role Quest's Upgraded Unleashed Teleport Cooldown: 330 - 240 seconds ⇒ 300 - 210 seconds
lines.attr: Top Role Quest's Upgraded Unleashed Teleport Cooldown

lines.text: Non-Top Unleashed Teleport Cooldown: 330 - 240 seconds ⇒ Unchanged

mayhem.title: ARAM: Mayhem
mayhem.intro: Hello Mayhemers! In this patch, we're focusing on bugfixes and small quality-of-life improvements. We're continuing to assess Augment offerings so that each Augment you're offered feels like a reasonable and meaningful option for your champion. For balance, High Roller has caught our attention for how powerful it can be when picked up early in the game. We're giving it another nerf to bring down some of that early snowballing potential. See you on the Bridge!

lines.text: Fixed a bug where Clown College used the wrong text color for true damage.

Fixed a bug where Multishot had extra quest step requirements for Nami's and Ezreal's ultimate abilities.
Fixed a bug where Yuumi could spam Bilgewater Cannon landing effects when she was attached to a unit.
Fixed a bug where Bursting Teeth did not trigger due to a per-target cooldown.
Fixed a bug where Bel'Veth's Q did not reset after using her ultimate when she had Ultimate Awakening.
Fixed a bug where Item Quest Progress broke when re-adding quest Augment offerings.
Fixed a bug where Vel'Koz's W did not get the correct refund with Skilled Sniper.
Fixed a bug where removing Upgrade Ravenous resulted in negative Life Steal for all your items.

entries.name: 黑暗之女 安妮
entries.summary: 安妮最近在普通玩家中的表现有些低迷，所以团队打算为她增加一些火力，并且还会帮忙支持她的灼烧流提伯斯玩法。

lines.text: 提伯斯生命值：1150 - 3500 (随英雄等级提升) (+50%法术强度) ⇒ 1275 - 4000 (随英雄等级提升) (+50%法术强度) (+150%额外生命值)
lines.after: 1275 - 4000 (随英雄等级提升) (+50%法术强度) (+150%额外生命值)

entries.name: 沙漠皇帝 阿兹尔
entries.summary: 又见面了，鸟皇。团队一直在关注阿兹尔从站位拉扯转向【致命节奏】后的表现。他在26.21版本的增强效果没有达到预期，所以这次团队会再给他一些关照。请注意，攻击距离的提升不会影响他使用士兵时的攻击范围，仅在他只能用普通攻击时才会生效！

lines.text: 攻击特效/命中特效 效能：50% ⇒ 67%
lines.attr: 攻击特效/命中特效 效能

entries.name: 星界游神 巴德
entries.summary: 在今年早些时候针对职业赛场的削弱后，巴德的表现一直较为疲软，而且已经完全不再出法强装备了。所以，团队稍微提升了他的Q技能基础伤害和收益率。

entries.name: 探险家 伊泽瑞尔
entries.summary: 伊泽瑞尔在今年的大部分段位表现一直不佳，尽管在职业赛场上依然非常热门。现在，随着职业赛季的结束，团队为他带来了一些增强，让他在你们的对局中表现得更出色。

entries.name: 正义巨像 加里奥
entries.summary: 加里奥最近有些乏力，团队想抽时间为他带来一些增强，特别是帮助他那些较弱的偏法强半肉流出装，而不仅仅是帮助他当前的高法强玩法。

entries.name: 迷失之牙 纳尔
entries.summary: 和伊泽瑞尔一样，纳尔可能是职业选手的上路热门选择，但在其他段位的表现并不理想，所以团队将加强他的投掷能力，助他一臂之力。

parts.title: Q - 投掷回力标/投掷顽石

entries.name: 纳祖芒荣耀 奎桑提
entries.summary: 奎桑提依然是全球总决赛的赛场常客，但对其他玩家来说，他的表现却远远落后，尤其是在后期，他不像大多数坦克那样稳定，反而会断崖式下跌。

entries.name: 诡术妖姬 乐芙兰
entries.summary: 乐芙兰的伤害目前有些过高，尤其是她非常可靠的Q技能。因此，团队下调了她的技能成长收益率，降低她的压制力——尤其是在她滚起雪球时。

lines.text: 法术强度收益率(初始和标记)40%法术强度 ⇒ 35%法术强度

entries.name: 无极剑圣 易
entries.summary: 团队一直在过去几个版本中关注着易，直到各种增强、他的Q技能冷却时间返还、品质级调整以及整体的打野格局都稳定下来。团队认为他依然有些过强，这次调整主要针对他目前主流的暴击出装，而不是他的特效流。

lines.after: 35 / 70 / 105 / 140 / 175 (+105%攻击力)请注意，这个伤害也可以暴击并造成额外伤害。

entries.name: 流光镜影 梅尔
entries.summary: 梅尔的全面更新总体达到了团队的预期，实现了适度的增强，同时并未影响她的禁用率。她目前的强度依然略微弱于标准强度，并且火力稍显不足，所以团队会稍微提升她的Q和W技能的强度。

entries.name: 暗黑元首 辛德拉
entries.summary: 辛德拉的晕眩感觉有点过于随时可用了，所以团队提高了它的消耗，并且延长了前期的冷却时间。这些改动同样旨在确保团队不会让她更加依赖高技能急速装备，并限制她规避“在法力值上进行投入”的能力。

entries.name: 虚空之眼 维克兹
entries.summary: 维克兹的数值计算出现了一个小错误。他对团队非常不满，但这不会对他的强度产生实际影响。

parts.title: R - 生命形态瓦解射线

entries.name: 皮城执法官 蔚
entries.summary: 职业赛季已经结束，团队希望稍微增强一些蔚的实力，让她在排位赛中表现更好。

entries.name: 电震涡流剑
entries.summary: 【电震涡流剑】在作为爆发和远程消耗型穿甲装备时都显得有些过于强势。爆发能力对刺客的作用比单纯的远程消耗更为重要，因此团队下调了其触发伤害。

lines.text: 额外伤害： [9% || 7%]目标当前生命值 ⇒ [8% || 6%]目标当前生命值

mayhem.title: 海克斯大乱斗
mayhem.intro: 团队这次为海斗带来了更多内容和平衡性改动！四位全新赛季之星即将登场，带来全新玩法体验。无论你是想通过【比特狂飙】获得重生机会，用【彼岸灵花】守护队友，靠【执事乐队】发财致富，还是用【音乐大师】寻找完美强化符文，团队都期待你尽情享受这场盛宴。 团队也一直关注新赛季的表现，并倾听大家的反馈。现在的防御塔倒得有点太快了，几乎无法拖慢敌人，也没法为队伍争取到多少时间。团队正在尝试调整防御塔的玩法，并提升它们的防御力，避免比赛瞬间结束。 坦克英雄在混战中一直难以招架，所以团队将推出四个全新的坦克专属强化符文，让这些更为耐打的英雄能够持续奋战。团队还将对英雄进行新一轮的平衡调整，帮助一些表现不佳的英雄，同时削弱部分过于强势的英雄。最后，团队将削弱【弹跳蜜蜂】和【鼓声暴起 低音轰鸣】，它们最近造成的伤害有些超出团队的预期。 一如既往，感谢大家的游玩，欢迎持续反馈！

entries.name: 新增 坚不可破
entries.summary: 获得20护甲，然后额外护甲提高25%。

entries.name: 新增 秘术卫士
entries.summary: 获得20魔法抗性，然后额外魔法抗性提高25%。

entries.name: 新增 史莱姆时间
entries.summary: 每几秒，自动施放来自你身体的一团粘液，对附近的敌人们造成魔法伤害。如果你命中了一个英雄，则会分泌出一个液团，在你走上去时治疗你。

entries.name: 新增 超坚定风采
entries.summary: 获得额外护甲、魔法抗性和韧性。当你低于40%最大生命值时，该加成会提升。

entries.name: 鼓声暴起 低音轰鸣
新增 比特狂飙
entries.summary: 通过参与击杀敌人收集代币。消耗4枚代币，在死亡时复活。

entries.name: 新增 执事乐队
entries.summary: 强化符文还会提供额外金币。

entries.name: 新增 彼岸灵花
entries.summary: 友军阵亡时会掉落一支蜡烛。拾取它即可为你和附近的队友提供护盾。

entries.name: 新增 音乐大师
entries.summary: 从4个强化符文中进行选择。

lines.text: 棱彩阶锻造器：每队每局限用1次

entries.name: 防御塔镀层
entries.summary: 【海克斯大乱斗】中的防御塔现在拥有120护甲和120魔法抗性，且不会随着游戏进行而降低。 外侧防御塔和召唤水晶防御塔现在拥有防御塔镀层。镀层会将生命值条分为三段，每摧毁一层镀层，附近的队伍成员将平分100金币。当防御塔的镀层被摧毁时，防御塔会获得【壁垒】增益：每有一名附近的英雄，便获得60-80双抗。（注：经实测，不会因附近英雄的增加而获得更多双抗，将于后续版本修复）

entries.name: 铸星龙王 奥瑞利安·索尔
entries.summary: 大多数奥瑞利安·索尔玩家都明确表示，他们更愿意优先升级【星芒凝汇】(E)作为副升技能，而不是【星穹流丽】(W)，即使【星芒凝汇】作为副升技能要弱得多。团队同意他的(E)是一个非常酷炫的标志性技能，所以会加强它，帮助玩家把这个直观又有趣的操作变成最佳选择。

entries.name: 英勇投弹手 库奇
entries.summary: 进入全球总决赛时，团队在库奇的强度上较为谨慎，但现在(就像阿兹尔和奥莉安娜一样)，他还有提升空间，来对所有玩家都更加友好。

entries.name: 正义天使 凯尔
entries.summary: 自从今年早些时候游戏经历了上路任务的变动后，凯尔的重要性一直在逐渐下降。团队对她进行了小幅增强，帮助她更好地度过前期线上阶段，因为团队认为上路需要更多具备成长性的选择。

entries.name: 灰烬驱魔人 洛克
entries.summary: 虽然洛克整体表现尚属合理，但他展现出的深度远超团队最初的预期，已经掌握高阶玩法的玩家依然能让他表现得过于强势，尤其是在前期。

entries.name: 扭曲树精 茂凯
entries.summary: 茂凯今年一直非常沉寂，几乎完全被固定在辅助位置。团队会以对他进行加强，来让他在上路和打野两个位置都能脱离困境。

entries.name: 流光镜影 梅尔
entries.summary: 本次版本更新，梅尔将迎来一次中型调整。你也可以在这里阅读更多详情。简而言之，她的一部分强度将从前期转移到后期成长，她的W技能将全面更新为一个范围性投射物摧毁技能，会进行反击而不是反射，她的Q和R技能也会调整，后期冷却时间会降低，让她能够叠加被动到更高层数。

lines.text: 每道后续飞弹的额外伤害：8 - 30 (+4%法术强度) ⇒ 4 - 30 (+4%法术强度)
lines.attr: 每道后续飞弹的额外伤害

lines.attr: 第一层对小兵造成的伤害

弹体速度：3800 ⇒ 3200(到达最远距离所需时间增加0.047秒)

parts.title: W - 灵魂折镜 - 全面更新

entries.name: 百裂冥犬 纳亚菲利
entries.summary: 在今年早些时候经历了一系列削弱后，纳亚菲利几乎已经完全退出了中路，在打野位的表现也相当平庸。团队将为她带来一次增强，应该有助于帮她在中路位脱离困境，让她的各位置强度更接近对等。

entries.name: 机械公敌 兰博
entries.summary: 和库奇一样，兰博也得到了针对职业赛场的调整。这个改动对普通玩家的帮助应该会比职业选手更大，等他们赶上版本更新后就能感受到。

lines.text: 最大伤害法术强度收益率：175%法术强度 ⇒ 200%法术强度
lines.attr: 最大伤害法术强度收益率

entries.name: 暮光之眼 慎
entries.summary: 和茂凯一样，打野慎也已经过于远离战术格局。团队一直在关注前几个版本对打野坦克的帮助是否能让他回归，但现在团队有信心可以直接加强他了。

entries.name: 炽炎雏龙 斯莫德
entries.summary: 前几轮的加强效果比团队的预期要温和一些，但他现在的暴击和法术装备流派之间已经达到了不错的平衡，所以这次团队会给他一个更通用的加强。预计本次版本中【多兰之弓】的削弱也会对他有所帮助。

entries.name: 魂锁典狱长 锤石
entries.summary: 尽管团队之前削弱过锤石，但他依然稳居高端玩家辅助榜首，所以这次团队将再次对他进行调整。

entries.name: 奥术先驱 维克托
entries.summary: 上个版本对维克托的削弱比团队预期的影响更大——不过团队还算满意他前期压制力的降低，因此这次团队将提升他的后期成长能力。

entries.name: 疾风剑豪 亚索
entries.summary: 上个版本团队还在犹豫是否需要像削弱永恩一样削弱亚索。随着玩家转向暴击出装，亚索的胜率也持续上升，禁用率也是一样，所以这次他也会受到同样的调整。

entries.name: 不落魔锋 亚恒
entries.summary: 亚恒实现了他的大后期之梦，但他在线上还没有太多事情可做。下面的改动会让他前期的对拼和小规模战斗更有爽感。

entries.name: 多兰之弓
entries.summary: 团队对【多兰之弓】进行了小幅削弱，因为它目前的强度略高于预期，导致本应倾向于【多兰之刃】的射手直接毫不犹豫地选择它。

entries.name: 霸王血铠
entries.summary: 【霸王血铠】本应是顶级重装战士的终极装备之一，但除了瑟提之外，它并没有足够的强度让玩家愿意为其冒险。团队正在调整【霸王血铠】，这次改动对大多数其他使用者来说整体应该是一次增强，但团队同时也希望瑟提的强度不要提升过多。他的【蓄意轰拳】(W)与它的【报复】被动有很强的联动，所以他会是受益最大的英雄。

mayhem.title: 海克斯大乱斗
mayhem.intro: 各位超级巨星们好！本次更新团队将削弱部分新登场的强化符文，增强一些生存类强化符文，并修复大量BUG。团队一直在关注新版本中的战斗伤害爆炸情况，并希望缓解一些令人沮丧的局势。 战士在终结比赛方面表现得异常出色，而在最近的版本中，远程消耗英雄(俗称丢丢怪)主导了前期，坦克则一直处于劣势。团队计划削弱一些让坦克感觉过于脆的强化符文，例如【将他们放倒倒倒】和【命运之武器】。团队还将提升【吞噬灵魂】和【保持坚定】等生存类强化符文的强度。团队正在关注整体爆发和游戏节奏，确保对局不会让人感觉过于滚雪球。 舞美人员也已完成【屠夫之桥】和【莲华栈桥】的布置，这两张地图会携着巨星风采回归轮换池。 随着全球总决赛火热进行，巨星之路的最后一页现已解锁。完成所有任务，登上全球总决赛的舞台，赢取全部奖励！还有两个全新强化符文加入战局，其中之一灵感来自经典全球总决赛主题曲，绝对会让你的对手对你印象深刻。 一如既往，感谢大家的游玩和宝贵反馈！

lines.text: 基础伤害成长：75 - 200 + 150%总攻击力 + 70%总法术强度 ⇒ 75 - 140 + 150%总攻击力 + 70%总法术强度

修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：【珠光护手】在搭配【魔法转物理】和【物理转魔法】时未正确提供暴击几率。
修正了小蜜蜂乐队赛季之星的说明文本，使其与实际效果一致。
修复了一个【深红钴蓝闪光】的BUG，该BUG曾导致：一些英雄的强化普攻未能消耗该标记。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：五杀乐队赛季之星在18级时未能为【乌迪尔】的终极技能提供一次升级。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：卡尔玛的梵咒强化技能未计入终极技能伤害K/DA乐队任务。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：超级巨星任务描述未正确显示。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：【热舞怪兽】的减速效果在死亡后依然持续。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：【命运之武器】在被强化的装备发生转化时，会切换强化对象。

entries.name: 沙漠皇帝 阿兹尔
entries.summary: 团队之前刻意限制了这位沙漠皇帝的法力值储备，以确保他在对线初期必须合理利用沙兵的攻击来控线，而非仅仅无脑频繁施放【Q狂沙猛攻】。然而，鉴于现在升级【W沙兵现身】能带来显著的收益，这种法力限制显得过于严苛了。团队加强了他的成长法力值，好让他能更加自如地使用他的技能来争抢线权。

entries.name: 皮城女警 凯特琳
entries.summary: 凯特琳在过去数月里对大多数玩家而言始终保持着极高的禁用率和选用率，尽管团队针对其他射手英雄以及下路生态环境进行过调整。因此，是时候削弱她了。团队早就觉得她的后期成长能力过于强劲了。因此，团队将她的一部分强度从她“惊爆眼球的满装爆头”中转移到了“游戏前期的Q技能伤害”上，从而重新平衡她的强度曲线。

lines.text: 伤害：60 - 100%攻击力(每1%暴击几率+1%攻击力) (每1%额外暴击伤害+1%攻击力) ⇒ 60 - 80%攻击力(每1%暴击几率+1%攻击力) (每1%额外暴击伤害+1%攻击力)
lines.before: 60 - 100%攻击力(每1%暴击几率+1%攻击力) (每1%额外暴击伤害+1%攻击力)
lines.after: 60 - 80%攻击力(每1%暴击几率+1%攻击力) (每1%额外暴击伤害+1%攻击力)

entries.name: 诺克萨斯之手 德莱厄斯
entries.summary: 德莱厄斯现在更偏向于一套爆发秒人的玩法，过于偏离了“需要被风筝、又肉又有输出的危险人物”这一风格。由于他还有成长空间，团队稍微增强了他，让他在持久战中能更频繁地挥动战斧。

entries.name: 暴走萝莉 金克丝
entries.summary: 和她的闺蜜凯特琳一样，金克丝在当前版本依然非常强势，即使在上个版本【飓风】被削弱之后。团队正在削弱她的节奏，让她更难滚起雪球。

entries.name: 盲僧 李青
entries.summary: 自从李青的【W金钟罩】与友军互动时的冷却时间得到调整后，他一直非常受欢迎。虽然团队喜欢这为他带来的额外灵活性，但这也让他有点过于强势，所以团队会稍微削弱他的冷却时间，并修复一个关于他的E技能在显形隐身敌人时的小问题，同时还会小幅削弱他的【R猛龙摆尾】伤害。

entries.name: 灰烬驱魔人 洛克
entries.summary: 洛克上线已经有一段时间了，团队现在能更清楚地看到他在哪些方面表现过于出色，哪些方面还有些不足。前者包括他极为强大的法力调整和抗骚扰能力，并且团队还略微提升了他的技能伤害成长来略微改善他的强度曲线，因为如果他无法在前期结束比赛，他的表现就会迅速下滑。

lines.text: 未使用充能返还：20 - 35%法力值和冷却时间返还 ⇒ 10 - 40%法力值和冷却时间返还
根据当前生命值的灰色生命值储存：40-200 (基于等级的部分) ⇒ 20-200 (基于等级的部分)
lines.attr: 根据当前生命值的灰色生命值储存

lines.text: 当前生命值储存：150 - 450 (基于等级的部分) ⇒ 100 - 500 (基于等级的部分)

entries.name: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐
entries.summary: 厄运小姐在今年整体表现还算不错，但随着这个版本对【狂妄】的削弱，团队打算通过提升她的伤害来进行一些补偿。

entries.name: 狂野女猎手 奈德丽
entries.summary: 这位广受喜爱的女猎手在高水平段位的胜率一直居高不下，已经接近过强的边缘，哪怕她现在并不算主流选择。由于团队正在削弱其他一些强势的主流打野英雄，比如盲僧，因此也对奈德丽进行了一些小幅削弱，以防她变得过于强势。

entries.name: 雪原双子 努努和威朗普
entries.summary: 今年早些时候，团队不希望远程法师只是为了位移而购买【海克斯科技火箭腰带】，因此削弱了它。于是某个小男孩和他的雪人失去了一些强度，所以团队现在会在其他地方补回一部分伤害。

entries.name: 发条魔灵 奥莉安娜
entries.summary: 团队提升了奥莉安娜的技能成长性，让她在后期用招牌连招打出更高爆发的同时，不会让她在对线期变得过强。

entries.name: 元素女皇 奇亚娜
entries.summary: 奇亚娜的Q技能造成的伤害比团队预期的要高得多，因此团队将部分回调她在26.17版本获得的加强。

parts.title: Q - 元素之怒 / 以绪塔尔之锋

entries.name: 披甲龙龟 拉莫斯
entries.summary: 虽然奈德丽在高水平局的胜率已经快要超出“过于强势”这条线了，但拉莫斯几乎碾过了其他所有人，所以他也会得到小幅削弱。

entries.name: 符文法师 瑞兹
entries.summary: 在26.19版本对瑞兹前期的大幅削弱后，即使他发挥出色，也无法获得足够的回报，所以团队将提升他的后期表现。

entries.name: 亡灵战神 赛恩
entries.summary: 这位广受喜爱的重装战士在最近的版本中好像没那么不可阻挡了。团队会提升他的基础耐久力，并且奖励他用大招成功“落位”而不是逃跑。

lines.text: 引导最初3秒内的伤害提升：+0 - 166.67%基础伤害，0 - 100%收益伤害 ⇒ +0 - 200%
lines.attr: 引导最初3秒内的伤害提升

lines.text: BUG修复：现在的说明文本会正确显示最小和最大额外攻击力收益率(40-120%)。之前显示了错误的额外攻击力收益率(60%-120%)。实际上在25.16版本并没有改动它。

entries.name: 岩雀 塔莉垭
entries.summary: 塔莉垭是为数不多的法师打野之一，团队认为她可以得到更多支持，以丰富版本格局的多样性。团队会提升她的【E撒石阵】伤害，让她的控制连招命中时更加爽快。

lines.text: 野怪伤害：对野怪造成225%伤害。

entries.name: 瓦洛兰之盾 塔里克
entries.summary: 团队正在打磨塔里克的技能组，让他能够更加闪耀。很久以前，为了对抗当时流行的易加塔里克的让经济战术，团队调整了塔里克的W技能。造成的一个结果是，如果他绑定的友军在他施放技能的同时变为不可被选取，他的技能就会失效。鉴于现在有了分路任务，团队认为对他技能机制的这一严苛限制已无必要，因此会部分回调这一改动，现在技能可以作用于不可被选取的友军，但【E炫光】仍然会不适用那些在屏幕上消失的英雄，因为这会导致相关玩法过于不清晰（抱歉了，易）。

entries.name: 麦林炮手 崔丝塔娜
entries.summary: 崔丝塔娜的前期线上现在有点变成了“1级按[Q] ，然后疯狂普攻，直接掌控整条线”，这种玩法既无趣又不符合她的特色。团队削弱了她前期的[Q]攻击速度，这样她必须多下点功夫才敢扑向敌人。

entries.name: 卡牌大师 崔斯特
entries.summary: 除了塔里克的体验优化外，团队也为崔斯特的R技能带来了同样的调整，现在即使敌方英雄在施放技能时处于无法被选中的状态，也能被显形。

entries.name: 惩戒之箭 韦鲁斯
entries.summary: 在这轮改动中，团队主要针对上路韦鲁斯出手，因为他在上路通常主W，而不像下路更常见的主Q。这不会让他的【Q穿刺之箭】恢复到之前穿甲韦鲁斯的强度，但会大幅增加下路韦鲁斯技能的调整空间。作为满级技能，它为韦鲁斯和他的对手提供了更多互动玩法，而不仅仅是W技能上的被动伤害。

lines.text: 伤害计算：最大伤害增长，53.33 - 240(+80%额外攻击力)至80 - 360(+120%额外攻击力) ⇒ 最小伤害增长，50 - 230(+80%额外攻击力)至85 - 391(+136%额外攻击力)

entries.name: 虚空之眼 维克兹
entries.summary: 维克兹今年一直是个相当冷门的选择，在中路和辅助位置几乎没有存在感，也无法对玩法产生影响。团队希望给他一点小小的帮助，方法是让他在打出连招时获得更多回报。

entries.name: 机械先驱 维克托
entries.summary: 是时候迎接光荣进化了。看起来维克托已经进化到几乎没有可被利用的弱点了，因此团队将稍微加深他在前期遭遇战和各个方面的脆弱性。

entries.name: 齐天大圣 孙悟空
entries.summary: 和李青、奇亚娜一样，孙悟空在打野位上也已经成为了版本热门，能只手翻云覆雨的强力存在。团队希望削弱他在打野位的强度，同时补偿他的打线位。

lines.text: 每层护甲：6 - 10 (基于英雄等级) ⇒ 4.5 - 10 (基于英雄等级)

entries.name: 德邦总管 赵信
entries.summary: 在【焚天】削弱后，团队认为赵信的物理半肉和攻速流出装都有提升空间，因此团队将加强他的成长性。

lines.text: 攻击速度收益：1%每5%额外攻击速度(来自永久来源) ⇒ 1%每4%额外攻击速度(来自永久来源)
lines.before: 1%每5%额外攻击速度(来自永久来源)
lines.after: 1%每4%额外攻击速度(来自永久来源)

entries.name: 封魔剑魂 永恩
entries.summary: 最近对永恩的改动成功让他在选择首个大件时开始考虑暴击，但同时也让他变得有些过强。团队会对他进行适度削弱，让他的强度稍微下降一些。

entries.name: 荆棘之兴 婕拉
entries.summary: 和维克兹一样，婕拉在当前版本中影响力较小，因为坦克和软辅一直占据主导地位。这个版本会让婕拉的园艺更上一层楼，帮助她对抗那些肆意践踏她植物的敌人。

entries.name: 破垒者
entries.summary: 【破垒者】之前被增强成了一件属性全面的装备，目的是让它在版本格局中有所建树。现在，团队会削弱这件装备的通用强度，同时带来一些体验优化，让它在特定生态位上依然令人满意。

lines.text: 成型炸药 伤害：近战: 50+1.5x穿甲；远程:25+0.75x穿甲 ⇒ 近战: 40+1.5x穿甲；远程:20+0.75x穿甲
蓄意破坏 持续时间：90秒 ⇒ 无限

lines.text: 蓄意破坏 持续时间说明：这是你可对战略点造成额外伤害的时间。

entries.name: 黎明核心
entries.summary: 【黎明核心】本该是辅助型装备的终极之选，但现在只有索拉卡会选择它。其他辅助即使在装备成型后，通常也会选择购买其他装备。团队会提升它的法术强度数额，让它不再仅仅依赖于治疗和护盾效果。

lines.text: 每100%基础法力回复提供的法术强度：10 ⇒ 15
lines.attr: 每100%基础法力回复提供的法术强度

entries.name: 暴食胫甲
entries.summary: 这双靴子在被射手们使用时的表现过于出色，即使只有几层也依然强力，因此团队将提高其价格，以延缓前期购买带来的过高收益。

entries.name: 狂妄
entries.summary: 虽然【狂妄】对近战英雄来说有些偏弱，但它在远程英雄手中表现明显过强。团队现在将两者区分开来，目的是鼓励近战英雄使用，同时让远程英雄不再倾向于选择它。

lines.text: 基础额外攻击力：12 ⇒ 15(近战) / 10(远程)
每层额外攻击力：3 ⇒ 3(近战) / 2(远程)

mayhem.title: 海克斯大乱斗
mayhem.intro: 欢迎来到【海克斯大乱斗】最新赛季 - “巨星之路”。群星们闪耀登场，因为海斗的每一场对局现在都将包含一场“赛季之星”演出，为每局游戏的规则带来独特的变数。在你战斗的同时，这些知名乐队将演奏各自的乐曲，因此要确保你开启了声音并调大了音量！ 舞台乐队通告：由于在【屠夫之桥】和【莲华栈桥】搭建音乐会舞台所需的时间比预期稍长，这两张地图将不会出现在26.21版本的海斗队列中，但会在26.22版本中回归。 除了这些赛季之星们，还有成吨的新增强化符文供大家享用。在这个赛季，团队还将删除一些强化符文并向它们深情道别。但谁知道呢？也许有一天它们会回来进行返场演出。 团队还推出了全新的进度体验：你将完成来自K/DA、五杀乐队以及更多其他乐队的任务。完成这些任务即可解锁炫酷奖励，如强化符文、表情、橙色精萃等！游玩游戏并完成任务，将使你抬升巨星咖位从而解锁新的乐队和新的任务。从【默默无闻】的新人，一路打拼成在全球总决赛舞台表演的【超级巨星】！

lines.text: K/DA：收集4张K/DA明星卡即可赚取一个额外的强化符文！
心之钢：强化符文可以附带独特的贴纸来变得更加强力。
真实伤害：参与击杀和摧毁防御塔可以掉落锻造器供你的队伍使用。
五杀乐队：在游戏开始时和18级时，强化你的一个技能。
迪斯科：在迪斯科灯球下跳舞，即可为每个人赚取金币。
咖啡甜心：治疗圣物（加血包）会特别强力。
小蜜蜂：收集蜂蜜并躲开那些飞越地图的小蜜蜂。
命令行：在每次强化符文选择中，可将你的一个强化符文刷新成一个更高位阶的强化符文。

使用一个特定技能时，会为你提供可叠加的攻击速度。

从你的装备获得的所有额外生命值转化为穿甲。
你在接近最大攻击距离处打出的攻击造成额外伤害。
获得基于你的额外生命值的法术强度。

从你的装备获得的所有法力回复转化为法术强度。
你的护盾会提升移动速度。
参与击杀后，会返还你的一部分终极技能冷却时间。
使用一个技能时，会使你的下一次普攻造成基于你护甲的额外伤害。
你的技能会周期性地对敌人们掷出一个爆炸蜂巢，来造成伤害、减速并附带攻击特效。
获得一个召唤师技能，它可使你蓄力一次号角爆音来击退并伤害你的敌人们。
你的一个技能会标记敌方英雄，在消耗该标记时会造成额外伤害并降低你该技能的冷却时间。
快速且连续地用两个不同的技能对敌方英雄造成伤害时，会提供永久法力值并造成额外伤害。

获得一个召唤师技能，它可使你跳到一个毁灭性的飞弹上并驾驭它冲向你的敌人们。
获得攻击力、法术强度和攻击速度，但降低你自己的移动速度。每次参与击杀后都会提升这个效果，并且阵亡时降低这个效果。
你的终极技能可以暴击。

entries.name: 鼓声暴起 低音轰鸣

lines.text: 施放技能后，你的下一次攻击造成额外伤害并为你提供爆发性的移动速度。
你从装备获得的所有额外攻击力转化为攻击速度。
当【风暴狂涌】施加【风啸】时，它会引爆一个区域，从而造成额外伤害并用一个次级【风啸】标记敌人们。
你购买的第一件传说装备会在每次参与击杀后获得更强力的属性。
你的很大一部分攻击速度转化为暴击伤害。
使用技能后，你的下一次普攻会弹跳至附近敌人，优先选择英雄。让你的攻击弹跳到敌方英雄身上来完成任务，可获得额外的弹跳次数和攻击力。
你的一个技能在提供治疗或护盾时还会为附近的友军提供治疗或护盾。
使用你的终极技能时，会为你提供额外生命值并在你周围生成一个地带来减速敌方英雄们。击杀和参与击杀会提升你获得的额外生命值数额以及减速地带的的范围。
攻击一个敌方英雄3次，即可造成爆发性的伤害并为你提供爆发性的攻击速度
获得一个召唤师技能，它可让你“与死亡共舞”，从而为你提供持续5秒的“不可被击杀”状态，但如果你在此期间未能获得一次参与击杀，那么你就会被拖入冥界（也就是阵亡）。

entries.name: 铁血狼母 安蓓萨
entries.summary: 安蓓萨在所有段位中，尤其是职业赛场上，对于高熟练度玩家来说，后期表现一直过于稳定。

entries.name: 寒冰射手 艾希
entries.summary: 艾希目前是职业赛场上最热门的射手之一。作为游戏中功能性最强的射手，她的伤害输出显得有些过高了。

entries.name: 魔蛇之拥 卡西奥佩娅
entries.summary: 团队在两个版本前对卡西奥佩娅的调整取得了预期效果：相比职业选手，大多数玩家受到的影响要小得多。不过，她在对线前期依然过于强势。因此团队再次收紧了她前期的资源，现在她需要更加努力才能建立优势。

entries.name: 皎月女神 黛安娜
entries.summary: 虽然黛安娜的刺客出装表现出色，但她的半肉出装明显落后。团队希望为半肉打法增添一些强度。

lines.text: 护盾 额外生命值收益率：11% ⇒ 14%
lines.attr: 护盾 额外生命值收益率

entries.name: 狂暴之心 凯南
entries.summary: 团队将加强他的招牌技能（也是他在《符文战场》中的招牌法术），为他再添一分胜算，同时补偿【火箭腰带】调整对他的不利影响。

entries.name: 永猎双子 千珏
entries.summary: 千珏目前有些偏弱，因此团队将给予一些加强，同时避免让他们在前期入侵时变得过于强势。期待他们会在强势阵容中占据一席之地，为赛场提供独特选择。

lines.text: 小型野怪目标选取：已启用 ⇒ 已移除

entries.name: 纳祖芒荣耀 奎桑提
entries.summary: 削弱了这位守护者在高配合度对局中作为盲选的可靠性——提高了前期法力消耗，并降低了W技能的持续伤害减免。这些调整预计将主要影响顶尖水平的对局。

lines.text: W技能 基础/最高伤害减免：30 / 75% ⇒ 25 / 70%
lines.attr: W技能 基础/最高伤害减免

entries.name: 含羞蓓蕾 莉莉娅
entries.summary: 上个版本，团队稍微加强了这只小鹿，但效果没有达到预期。团队认为，她在各个水平的对局中都还有进一步发挥的空间，因此决定再加强一次，助她大放异彩。

entries.name: 圣枪游侠 卢锡安
entries.summary: 上个版本，团队希望通过调整来缩小中路与下路的表现差距，结果削弱了其在下路的表现。因此，本次更新将追加加强，弥补失去的强度。

entries.name: 铁铠冥魂 莫德凯撒
entries.summary: 莫德凯撒在大招的冷却期间，很难跟上许多对手的节奏。随着游戏节奏加快，他的核心技能(Q)也会显得有些乏力，因此团队认为可以提升它在后期的伤害。

entries.name: 万花通灵 妮蔻
entries.summary: 本次【火箭腰带】的调整预计会小幅削弱妮蔻，因此团队将为她提供一些补偿性加强。

entries.name: 炽炎雏龙 斯莫德
entries.summary: 过去几个版本中，斯莫德的强度下降了不少。黑切的远程削弱以及下路格局的变化，都对他相当不利。团队将进一步加强暴击出装，让他的半肉出装和纯暴击出装在强度上更加接近。

lines.text: 【Q超级灼热龙息】额外魔法伤害：25-55%【龙之研习】层数 (如有【无尽之刃】+0-9%)，随暴击几率提升 ⇒ 25-60%【龙之研习】层数 (如有【无尽之刃】+0-10.5%)，随暴击几率提升

entries.name: 诺克萨斯统领 斯维因
entries.summary: 这个版本将适度加强中单斯维因，同时调整一些内容，应该有助于标准化他在中路与下路的表现。

entries.name: 河流之王 塔姆
entries.summary: 塔姆是生命回复最低的坦克辅助之一，且多个技能的收益都与生命值挂钩，因此近期辅助装备的调整对他影响较大。因此，团队会为他提供补偿性加强。

entries.name: 暗夜猎手 薇恩
entries.summary: 薇恩目前表现偏弱。虽然她在上路与下路的强度差距仍未完全达到团队的预期，但情况正在逐步改善。团队调整了她的基础属性，以帮助她在下路更好地应对骚扰，同时回退了此前对Q技能法力消耗的调整——那项改动带来的体验实在太差了。

entries.name: 不破之誓 芸阿娜
entries.summary: 芸阿娜最容易让对局变成“双方和平发育，坐等装备成型”的局面。团队希望避免这种玩法成为主流，尤其是在全球总决赛临近之际。

lines.text: 减速效果叠加：可与其他减速效果叠加 ⇒ 不再与其他减速效果叠加
lines.before: 可与其他减速效果叠加
lines.after: 不再与其他减速效果叠加

entries.name: 海克斯注力刚壁
entries.summary: 这件装备在远程英雄手中的表现一直不太符合团队的预期，尤其是在上路作为首件装备时：它让远程英雄过于容易扛住爆发伤害，又在全力对拼时拥有过高击杀能力。

lines.text: 由远程英雄持有时的效能：70%数值(35%攻击速度、14%移动速度) ⇒ 50%数值(25%攻击速度、10%移动速度)
lines.attr: 由远程英雄持有时的效能

entries.name: 海克斯科技火箭腰带
entries.summary: 【火箭腰带】依然更多被用作逃生工具，而不是高风险开团装备，因此团队将削弱它的通用收益，强化其进攻属性，尤其是让依赖它进场对拼的法强半肉英雄更能发挥其价值。

entries.name: 卢安娜的飓风
entries.summary: 这件装备之前加强得有点过头了，所以这次稍微回调一下。

entries.name: 记分板显示优化
entries.summary: 近期，团队对增益栏进行了系统性的清晰度优化，将许多数值从增益图标转移到了装备图标上。结果这些数字开始在计分板上疯狂刷存在感（说的就是你，死亡之舞）。记分板应展示对战术决策有价值的信息，瞬息万变的战斗状态数值则会造成干扰。因此，团队将隐藏记分板上的大部分装备图标计数。【女神之泪】系列装备、【梅贾的窃魂卷】等与战略相关的装备数值，依然会显示在记分板图标上。 以下装备的图标计数现在不再显示在记分板上：

mayhem.title: 海克斯大乱斗
mayhem.intro: 各位海斗狂热者，大家好！ 在本次版本更新中，团队将重点关照一些需要加强的英雄和强化符文。英雄方面，团队将引入英雄专属加强，在强化其核心打法的同时，让他们在海斗中更容易上手，玩起来也更有爽感。强化符文方面，团队将继续着重改善易用性。 例如，【咒语裂变】现在会在飞弹到达终点或技能再次施放时触发分裂，而不是在首次命中目标时触发分裂。团队还缩减了【扳机炼狱】的冷却时间，让玩家能够真正体验莎弥拉火力全开的快感。欢迎告诉团队这些调整的体验如何，感谢大家的游玩。 桥上见！

lines.text: 修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：【炼狱龙魂】和【珠光护手】会将对小兵造成的伤害计入统计。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：【尊我为王】在任务完成后仍占据栏位。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：【尊我为王】质变为【超负荷】后，后者无法生效。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：【鲨鱼诱饵】显示空白增益栏。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：阿萝拉的(Q)技能无法获得来自【老练狙神】的冷却缩减效果。（注：暂未生效，将于后续版本修复）
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：慎在使用【闪现】或排序施放其他技能时，【回响施放】复制的【奥义！影缚】(E)无法进行冲刺。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：移动指令可能会改变【回响施放】的复制体朝向。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：拥有【咒语裂变】的卢锡安在(W)技能施放期间使用(E)技能时，(W)技能的飞弹无法正常分裂。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：在技能施放期间施放召唤师技能，会导致【咒语裂变】的飞弹无法正常分裂。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：当施放被【咒语裂变】强化的技能时，英雄无法排序施放其他技能。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：【舞会女王】的冷却图标在死亡后消失。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：厄加特(W)技能的飞弹会摧毁【飞升仪式】的精华。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：【仆从大师】的伤害增幅对萨科(R)技能的爆炸伤害和艾翁(R)技能的击飞伤害不生效。
修复了一个BUG，该BUG曾导致：【终极九头蛇】的任务图标与卡牌图标不一致。

entries.name: 暗裔剑魔 亚托克斯
entries.summary: 团队认为【暗裔利刃】失去了相当一部分强度，原因是【焚天】被削弱，而削弱原因是为了开创野区的战术格局，因此团队给了他一点增强，好让他依然保持着足以毁灭世界的威胁力。

lines.text: 治疗的生命值收益率：1.1%每100额外生命值 ⇒ 1.3%每100额外生命值

entries.name: 残月之肃 厄斐琉斯
entries.summary: 厄斐琉斯近来一直未能站在聚光灯下，尽管他属于那种在软辅格局中理应如鱼得水的后期大核英雄，因此，团队打算对他进行小幅增强，以鼓励他走出他的舒适区。

lines.text: 减速：持续2.5秒的30%，在0.7秒后衰减至10% ⇒ 持续2.5秒的30%，在0.7秒后衰减至15%
